newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Limbs of three bodies found in bin bags in Belgium.
newsitem.headline: Limbs of three bodies found in bin bags in Belgium.

text.p: Belgian police said on Sunday they had found limbs belonging to at least three bodies, probably of women, in 10 plastic rubbish bags in the southern town of Cuesmes.

"We have found several limbs; feet, legs, arms, forearms, thighs and hands in litter bags. There were no trunks or heads. Based on the number of feet and hands, they must have belonged to at least three people, probably women," a police official in nearby Mons told Reuters.
The badly decomposed body parts were found on Saturday by a policeman in a deserted area under a bridge crossing the Paris-Brussels railway, the official said.
A first investigation showed that the deaths must have occurred between one week and two years ago, Belgian radio said.
Police said the bags had probably been thrown into the spot over a period of time.
"At least two of the bags must have been thrown there before the winter, considering the state of the grass underneath," a police official told Belgian radio RTBF.
Nothing is known about the identity of the victims or the potential killer or killers.

In a separate, apparently unrelated, find in the western village of Merelbeke, the skull of an elderly man was found in a plastic bag. National news agency Belga said the skull was from a man who had been buried in the local cemetery.
Police officials said they did not immediately suspect a link with gruesome discoveries made in a paedophile scandal which has rocked the country in the past nine months.
Since August, the bodies of five young girls have been found. In relation with the deaths, two convicted child sex offenders have been arrested and charged with abduction and rape of minors.
Police said the investigation into the origin of the limbs would focus on recent disappearances of women in Belgium and France.

The entire area around the railway bridge in Cuesmes was cordoned off and police brought in sniffer dogs to search for further evidence. A helicopter with infrared equipment was forced to halt its search by bad weather. The search will continue on Monday.
